entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I just want to return something, how hard can it be?! Get me a person, now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this helmet I bought. Your whole system is a joke. I want a return label, and I want it now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're frustrated. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sam Jones, order 88-1425-B. And don't give me the runaround. I've had it for a few weeks, the box unopened, and I just want my money back.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet. Can I ask what the specific issue is? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is the color is hideous! It looked completely different on your website. I don't want it. If you don't process this return, I'm going straight to your manager and then I'm posting reviews everywhere about this terrible service.
I understand completely, and I'm very sorry that the color wasn't what you expected. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date. Please hold for one moment.
You'd better. This is a simple request.

Thank you for your patience, Sam. I've confirmed everything. I see the helmet was delivered 21 days ago. Our policy for this item allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for you right now.
Wait, really? Just like that? You're approving it?

Yes, of course. We want to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit gear, and your safety is our top priority, which starts with a helmet you're comfortable with. I have just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. All you need to do is attach it to the original box and drop it off.
Oh. Okay, well... that's actually great. I was expecting a fight. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Once our warehouse receives the return, you'll see a full refund within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
